'''Alpha Squad''' was a military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Quesh]] around [[3642 BBY]]. They were send to retrieve combat adrenals from Republic forces, but were outmatched and twelve out of thirteen members were killed in action. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Molvar]] was the only survivor. Injured, he made his way to a nearby Imperial outpost and asked a fellow Imperial to finish his mission.
